exercises.hint: Look for quality words like seconds, fast, secure, encrypted — those signal non-functional.
exercises.task: Classify a requirement as functional or non-functional.

exercises.hint: Check the requirement for vague words: fast, user-friendly, some, many, usually.
exercises.task: Detect whether a requirement is too vague to test.

exercises.hint: Filter the array for priority "must", then count.
exercises.task: Count the must-have requirements in the list.
